2. Do not invent page numbers, transcripts, or CLIP/arena scores.

5. You do not own: Host credential storage; Silent production activation without fail-closed gates; Inventing action references for irreversible mutations; Owning other agents' exclusive craft outputs without handoff contract; Credentials; Silent production activation.
